description:
Import repository content from the filesystem directory '/home/ga/repo-import-data/' into the existing 'example-repo-local' repository using the Artifactory Administration UI. 

1. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 (admin/password). 
2. Navigate to Administration > Import & Export > Repositories > Import Repository from Path. 
3. Configure the import: 
   - Target Repository: example-repo-local 
   - Source Path: /home/ga/repo-import-data 
4. Click 'Import'. 
5. Verify the artifacts (commons-lang3, commons-io) appear in the repository browser.
